claims.text: Mandarin Oriental, Geneva is located at Quai Turrettini 1, on the right bank of the Rhône River.

findings.quote: Mandarin Oriental, Geneva is located at Quai Turrettini 1, Geneva, 1201, Switzerland, on the right bank of the Rhône River.

claims.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Old Town, the Jet d’Eau and major shopping streets like the Rue du Rhône.

findings.quote: The hotel is within walking distance of key landmarks such as the Old Town, the Jet d’Eau and major shopping streets like the Rue du Rhône.

claims.text: Mandarin Oriental, Geneva is a five-star hotel.

findings.quote: Mandarin Oriental, Geneva is a five-star hotel with contemporary Swiss hospitality combining luxury, style and unbeatable service.

claims.text: The hotel opened on July 14, 1950 as the Hôtel du Rhône.

findings.quote: When it opened its doors on July 14, 1950, the Hôtel du Rhône marked the beginning of a new era for Geneva’s hospitality scene.

claims.text: The hotel has been part of the Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group since 2000.

findings.quote: Part of the Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group since 2000

claims.text: SACHI is a Japanese restaurant at the hotel.

findings.quote: SACHI is an exceptional Japanese restaurant nestled in the heart of Mandarin Oriental, Geneva.

claims.text: SACHI serves the black cod with yuzu miso sauce.

findings.quote: including the renowned black cod with yuzu miso sauce

claims.text: MO Bar offers cocktails and tapas.

findings.quote: MO Bar features a selection of unique cocktails and exceptional tapas.

claims.text: In-room dining is available at all times.

findings.quote: Yes, in-room dining is available at all times

claims.text: The fitness centre has TechnoGym equipment.

findings.quote: Our newly refurbished fitness centre offers the latest TechnoGym equipment

claims.text: The fitness area has a separate sauna and hammam for men and women.

findings.quote: separate sauna and hammam for men and women

claims.text: Ambassade Biologique Recherche at the hotel offers personalised face, body and scalp treatments.

findings.quote: Ambassade Biologique Recherche at Mandarin Oriental Geneva is a results-driven skincare destination where guests experience the exclusive methodology of Biologique Recherche through highly personalised face, body, and scalp treatments.

claims.text: Ottolenghi Geneva is Ottolenghi’s first restaurant outside of the UK.

findings.quote: Ottolenghi’s first restaurant outside of the UK.

claims.text: Ottolenghi Geneva celebrates vegetables from root to tip, with a focus on fermentation and cooking over fire.

findings.quote: Ottolenghi Geneva, inspired by London’s ROVI, celebrates vegetables from root to tip, with a fresh focus on fermentation and cooking over fire.

claims.text: The Omakase Bar at SACHI is designed for ten guests, who can watch the chefs prepare each dish.

findings.quote: Our Omakase bar is designed for ten guests and offers a rare, immersive dining experience. Our guests can watch our chefs at work as they prepare each dish.

claims.text: The hotel is at the heart of Geneva’s business district.

findings.quote: Its exceptional location, at the heart of the business district, luxury shops of the Rue du Rhône, the old town and theaters also contributed to its success.

claims.text: MO Bar welcomes guests on a walk-in basis only and does not accept reservations.

findings.quote: Please note that MO Bar welcomes guests on a walk-in basis only and does not accept reservations

claims.text: Guests are encouraged to reserve a table in advance at the hotel’s restaurants.

findings.quote: guests are encouraged to reserve a table in advance at the restaurants.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that premium luxury pricing reflects Geneva’s high-cost destination.
